items.title: BTCPay restricts remote Lightning access after attackers steal funds
items.snippet: Foundation and Citadel21 reported drained Lightning nodes, but the total amount stolen and number of affected operators remain unknown.
items.note: Негативний тон для BTC за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.

items.title: Controversial Bitcoin fork BIP-110 mines two blocks, then stops
items.snippet: The breakaway chain inherited bitcoin’s mining difficulty with only a tiny share of hashpower, leaving blocks hours apart while both chains still accept the same transactions.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо BTC -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.
